method_spec.interval: statsmodels SARIMAX two-sided 95% Wald interval from fitted parameter covariance
method_spec.p_value: two-sided asymptotic normal Wald p-value for the trend coefficient

design.seed_derivation: SHA256(namespace + '|' + role + '|' + regime + '|' + slope formatted to 8 decimals + '|' + replicate), first 128 bits as unsigned integer

acceptance_criteria.residual_dependence_diagnostic: Ljung-Box at 12 and 24 calendar-month lags; p < 0.01 flags a residual-dependence failure
acceptance_criteria.mc_intervals: two-sided exact Clopper-Pearson 95% intervals for binomial rates; Student-t 95% intervals for continuous Monte Carlo means
acceptance_criteria.selection_rule: No candidate is reselected from confirmation. Every listed gate must pass in all three slope cells.

interpretation_limits: A passing result supports only the declared synthetic IID Gaussian error regime with 276 complete consecutive monthly observations and this exact model configuration.
It does not establish applicability to AR(1), ARMA, seasonal, missing-calendar, heavy-tailed, heteroskedastic, or real environmental series.
No real series is automatically classified as IID Gaussian; absent justified regime evidence, the analytical engine must remain exploratory and withhold inferential p-values and intervals.
The historical v1.2 selection and validation decisions remain immutable.
